I recall the isomorphism-class counts as about 41 for the 75 rod groups and about 53 for the 80 layer groups. None of the three proposed pairs, (57, 63), (33, 47) and (61, 68), matches that recollection. Each solution also cites its numbers as a "known fact" without any derivation.
